dynamics.update_order: alternating: D Adam step, then G+prior Adam step against the new D
dynamics.margin_proxy: nearest real in the current minibatch
dynamics.support_fence: median NN + 3 * 1.4826 * MAD of real nearest neighbors
dynamics.exhausted_margin: already past the fence and stepping out is placed on the fence; a thin interior margin cannot cross it
